outcome: conversion from N(2) O to neuraxial analgesia
adverse effects related to N(2) O use
cohort: 463 parturients aged at least 18 years who used inhaled N(2) O during the first or second stage of labor between March 1, 2016, and July 23, 2017, at one academic medical center, and their neonates
finding: Labor induction, oxytocin augmentation, and labor after cesarean were significant positive predictors for conversion from N(2) O to neuraxial analgesia, while multiparity and post-N(2) O cervical dilatation were negative predictors.
